summary_1line: Both armies assemble with vast forces and battle arrays; the Kauravas guard Bhishma while Yudhishthira orders Arjuna to form a compact Vajra formation led by Bhima.

image_candidates.scene_text: The king of the Kalingas and other rulers ride towering elephants adorned with banners, armor, and white umbrellas, the beasts looming like moving hills.
The battlefield erupts with conches, drums, elephant roars, and chariot wheels as glittering armies face each other beneath forests of golden standards.
Bhima stands at the front of the Pandava formation like a lion before the herd, warriors sheltering behind him as the Vajra array forms.
